joins:
FROM inventory_equipment_all e
 LEFT JOIN equipment_names n ON n.equipment_id=e.id AND n.unit_id=e.unit_id
 LEFT JOIN environments room ON room.id=e.environment_id AND room.unit_id=e.unit_id
 LEFT JOIN agent_equipment_links l ON l.link_id=(SELECT ll.link_id FROM agent_equipment_links ll WHERE ll.equipment_id=e.id AND ll.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY ll.linked_at DESC,ll.link_id DESC LIMIT 1)
 LEFT JOIN agent_devices d ON d.device_id=l.device_id
 LEFT JOIN agent_presence p ON p.device_id=l.device_id
 LEFT JOIN agent_current_snapshot cs ON cs.device_id=l.device_id
 LEFT JOIN agent_inventory_snapshots si ON si.inventory_id=cs.inventory_id
 LEFT JOIN agent_enrollments en ON en.device_id=l.device_id
live: SELECT l.link_id,l.device_id,l.equipment_id,l.linked_at,e.unit_id,e.environment_id,e.position_label,e.published_json,e.data_json,u.name AS unit_name,(SELECT name FROM environments WHERE id=e.environment_id AND unit_id=e.unit_id) AS environment_name,(SELECT name FROM equipment_names WHERE equipment_id=e.id AND unit_id=e.unit_id) AS display_name,(SELECT json_extract(s.sections_json,'$.system.data.hostname') FROM agent_current_snapshot c JOIN agent_inventory_snapshots s ON s.inventory_id=c.inventory_id WHERE c.device_id=d.device_id) AS hostname,d.state,p.data_json AS presence_json FROM agent_equipment_links l JOIN agent_devices d ON d.device_id=l.device_id JOIN equipments e ON e.id=l.equipment_id JOIN units u ON u.id=e.unit_id LEFT JOIN agent_presence p ON p.device_id=d.device_id WHERE l.ended_at IS NULL AND d.state='linked' AND u.active=1
snapshots: SELECT s.*,l.link_id FROM agent_inventory_snapshots s JOIN agent_equipment_links l ON l.device_id=s.device_id AND l.equipment_id=s.equipment_id AND l.ended_at IS NULL JOIN equipments e ON e.id=s.equipment_id JOIN units u ON u.id=e.unit_id LEFT JOIN agent_monitor_cursors m ON m.device_id=s.device_id JOIN agent_current_snapshot c ON c.device_id=s.device_id JOIN agent_devices d ON d.device_id=s.device_id WHERE u.active=1 AND d.state='linked' AND ((m.device_id IS NULL OR m.link_id<>l.link_id) AND s.inventory_id=c.inventory_id OR (m.link_id=l.link_id AND CAST((julianday(s.collected_at)-2440587.5)*86400000+0.5 AS INTEGER)>m.collected_ms)) ORDER BY julianday(s.collected_at),s.inventory_id LIMIT 200
